body:
Hi, I tried to reproduce this issue on my Windows setup but could not observe the failure.

Environment:

 Windows 11
Python 3.13.7
 pytest 9.1.0.dev (latest main) and pytest 9.0.2

Test case used:

import subprocess
import sys

def test_popen_devnull_fails():
    p = subprocess.Popen(
        [sys.executable, "-c", "print('hello')"],
        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    )
    p.wait()
    assert p.returncode == 0

 pytest→ PASS
 pytest --capture=fd → PASS
 pytest --capture=sys → PASS
 pytest -s → PASS

This suggests the issue might be:

 Specific to Python 3.14 (I am using 3.13.7), or
 Dependent on a particular Windows handle/environment configuration

Could you please confirm:

 Whether this still reproduces on the latest pytest main branch?
 If there are any additional conditions required to trigger the issue?

Happy to help further once I can reproduce it reliably 👍
